''''' Archive for Mathematical Logic''''' is a [[peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[mathematics journal]] published by [[Springer Science+Business Media]]. It was established in 1950 and publishes articles on [[mathematical logic]].

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:<ref name=about>[https://www.springer.com/journal/153]. Springer. 2022</ref>
* [[Mathematical Reviews]]
* [[Zentralblatt MATH]]
* [[Scopus]]
* [[SCImago Journal Rank|SCImago]]

According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2020 [[impact factor]] of 0.287.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2021 |chapter=Archive for Mathematical Logic |title=2020 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]]|title-link=Journal Citation Reports }}</ref>
